name_reason: Compliant with global naming convention: data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>. Domain=chapter (ch07 = meaningful chapter ID 1-30, not an address residue), descriptor encodes end-scene character position X and the _table data-type suffix. No Ghidra address residue (table length 9 is not in the name). Name accurately reflects use confirmed by consumer fd2_chapter_07_end @ 0x232E8 passing it as param_1 (pX_byte_array) to fd2_setup_chars_and_camera_for_intro @ 0x233C6.
purpose: Const table of per-character battle-tile X coordinates for the 9 characters staged in the chapter-7 end/recruit cutscene (recruit char #12, 武者凱麗).
logic_summary: First of three parallel 9-byte tables (X @ 0x520E4, Y @ 0x520ED, facing @ 0x520F6). fd2_chapter_07_end block-copies all 9 bytes (decompiled as 4+4+1 partial-word stores) into an on-stack placement block, then passes &block as param_1 of fd2_setup_chars_and_camera_for_intro over inclusive char index range [0..8] (= 9 chars). Each byte is the X tile coord for one character. Values {12,11,13,10,14,10,14,9,15}, range 9..15.
element_semantics: element[i] = battle-tile X coordinate (uint8, no sign extension) for character at index i in the chapter-7 end-scene placement loop; 9 entries for the 9 staged characters.
